description: Followers on an arrow whose end is attached to a moving box. A grey S-curved arrow runs from a fixed point at the left middle of the frame to the left edge of a blue rounded plate, which slides from the upper right (frame 0) through the right middle (frame 10) to the lower right (frame 20). A yellow dot sits half way along the arrow (`follow.progress` held at 0.5) and a pink bar, oriented, sits 85% of the way along it. At every frame the dot is on the middle of the S and the bar is on the line near the plate, turned to run along it — so as the plate moves, both move with the arrow and the bar's tilt changes from climbing (frame 0) to level (frame 10) to descending (frame 20). What a wrong render looks like: the dot and bar staying put while the arrow moves means the follower read the arrow's authored geometry rather than its attached ends; either one off the drawn line means the path and the drawing disagree.
